    assign lsu_disp_mem_size      = id_mem_size;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Flush / free-list push helpers (constant-index row decode only)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [3:0]  flush_next4;
    logic [3:0]  flush_cnt4;
    logic [7:0]  flush_elig;
    logic [23:0] flush_rank;
    logic [31:0] flush_push_pos;
    logic [3:0]  flush_push_count;
    logic        alloc_push_en;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_push_data;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_slot_pdst;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_slot_old;

    assign flush_next4 = flush_rob_index + 4'd1;
    assign flush_cnt4  = cur_tail - flush_next4;

    // One 3-bit circular distance per checkpoint slot (row-decoded).
    logic [23:0] slot_dist;
    genvar gk;
    generate
        for (gk = 0; gk < 8; gk = gk + 1) begin : gen_dist
            assign slot_dist[3*gk +: 3] = gk[2:0] - flush_next4[2:0];
        end
    endgenerate

    // dist_lt[8*gw + k] = (distance of slot k) < (distance of slot gw)
    logic [63:0] dist_lt;
    genvar gd;
    generate
        for (gd = 0; gd < 8; gd = gd + 1) begin : gen_dist_lt
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 0] = (slot_dist[2:0]   < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 1] = (slot_dist[5:3]   < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 2] = (slot_dist[8:6]   < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 3] = (slot_dist[11:9]  < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 4] = (slot_dist[14:12] < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 5] = (slot_dist[17:15] < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 6] = (slot_dist[20:18] < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 7] = (slot_dist[23:21] < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign flush_elig[0] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[0  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[2:0]}   < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[1] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[6  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[5:3]}   < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[2] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[12 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[8:6]}   < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[3] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[18 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[11:9]}  < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[4] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[24 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[14:12]} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[5] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[30 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[17:15]} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[6] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[36 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[20:18]} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[7] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[42 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[23:21]} < flush_cnt4);

    assign flush_push_count = {3'd0, flush_elig[0]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[1]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[2]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[3]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[4]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[5]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[6]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[7]};

    genvar gr;
    generate
        for (gr = 0; gr < 8; gr = gr + 1) begin : gen_flush_rank
            assign flush_rank[3*gr +: 3] =
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[0] && dist_lt[8*gr + 0])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[1] && dist_lt[8*gr + 1])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[2] && dist_lt[8*gr + 2])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[3] && dist_lt[8*gr + 3])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[4] && dist_lt[8*gr + 4])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[5] && dist_lt[8*gr + 5])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[6] && dist_lt[8*gr + 6])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[7] && dist_lt[8*gr + 7])};
        end
    endgenerate

    assign flush_push_pos[3:0]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[2:0]};
    assign flush_push_pos[7:4]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[5:3]};
    assign flush_push_pos[11:8]  = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[8:6]};
    assign flush_push_pos[15:12] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[11:9]};
    assign flush_push_pos[19:16] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[14:12]};
    assign flush_push_pos[23:20] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[17:15]};
    assign flush_push_pos[27:24] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[20:18]};
    assign flush_push_pos[31:28] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[23:21]};

    assign alloc_slot_pdst = slot_pdst[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_slot_old  = slot_old[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_push_en   = (alloc_slot_pdst != PR_ZERO) && (alloc_slot_old != PR_ZERO);
    assign alloc_push_data = alloc_slot_old;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Restore winner per checkpoint slot.  At most one slot per
    // architectural register survives (the oldest eligible writer).
    // The slot rd inputs are isolated when no flush is active so the
    // 32 x 8 restore comparators do not toggle on the rename path.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [39:0] slot_rd_iso;
    logic [7:0]  slot_win;

    assign slot_rd_iso = {40{do_flush}} & slot_rd;

    genvar gw;
    generate
        for (gw = 0; gw < 8; gw = gw + 1) begin : gen_slot_win
            assign slot_win[gw] = flush_elig[gw] &&
                !( (flush_elig[0] && (slot_rd_iso[4:0]   == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 0]) ||
                   (flush_elig[1] && (slot_rd_iso[9:5]   == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 1]) ||
                   (flush_elig[2] && (slot_rd_iso[14:10] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 2]) ||
                   (flush_elig[3] && (slot_rd_iso[19:15] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 3]) ||
                   (flush_elig[4] && (slot_rd_iso[24:20] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 4]) ||
                   (flush_elig[5] && (slot_rd_iso[29:25] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 5]) ||
                   (flush_elig[6] && (slot_rd_iso[34:30] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 6]) ||
                   (flush_elig[7] && (slot_rd_iso[39:35] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 7]) );
        end
    endgenerate

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Next-state values (all continuous, fully driven, constant rows)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [255:0] rd_match;      // rd_match[8*ga + k] = slot k writes arch ga
    logic [191:0] spec_map_nxt;
    logic [95:0]  free_list_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_pdst_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_old_nxt;
    logic [39:0]  slot_rd_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_head_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_tail_nxt;
    logic [4:0]   free_count_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   cur_tail_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  ready_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  ready_set;
    logic [47:0]  ready_clr;

    genvar ga;
    generate
        for (ga = 0; ga < 32; ga = ga + 1) begin : gen_spec_map
            logic       hit;
            logic [5:0] rval;

            assign rd_match[8*ga + 0] = (slot_rd_iso[4:0]   == ga[4:0]);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 1] = (slot_rd_iso[9:5]   == ga[4:0]);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 2] = (slot_rd_iso[14:10] == ga[4:0]);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 3] = (slot_rd_iso[19:15] == ga[4:0]);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 4] = (slot_rd_iso[24:20] == ga[4:0]);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 5] = (slot_rd_iso[29:25] == ga[4:0]);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 6] = (slot_rd_iso[34:30] == ga[4:0]);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 7] = (slot_rd_iso[39:35] == ga[4:0]);

            assign hit = |(rd_match[8*ga +: 8] & slot_win);

            assign rval =
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 0] & slot_win[0]}} & slot_old[5:0])   |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 1] & slot_win[1]}} & slot_old[11:6])  |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 2] & slot_win[2]}} & slot_old[17:12]) |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 3] & slot_win[3]}} & slot_old[23:18]) |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 4] & slot_win[4]}} & slot_old[29:24]) |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 5] & slot_win[5]}} & slot_old[35:30]) |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 6] & slot_win[6]}} & slot_old[41:36]) |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 7] & slot_win[7]}} & slot_old[47:42]);

            assign spec_map_nxt[6*ga +: 6] =
                (do_alloc && need_pr && (id_rd == ga[4:0])) ? rd_prd :
                (do_flush && hit)                           ? rval   :
                                                              spec_map[6*ga +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    // Operand isolation for the free-list push network: the flush push
    // sources are constant zero outside a flush.
    logic [31:0] push_pos_iso;
    logic [47:0] slot_pdst_iso;

    assign push_pos_iso  = {32{do_flush}} & flush_push_pos;
    assign slot_pdst_iso = {48{do_flush}} & slot_pdst;

    genvar gfl;
    generate
        for (gfl = 0; gfl < 16; gfl = gfl + 1) begin : gen_free_list
            assign free_list_nxt[6*gfl +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[0] && (push_pos_iso[3:0]   == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst_iso[5:0]   :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[1] && (push_pos_iso[7:4]   == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst_iso[11:6]  :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[2] && (push_pos_iso[11:8]  == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst_iso[17:12] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[3] && (push_pos_iso[15:12] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst_iso[23:18] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[4] && (push_pos_iso[19:16] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst_iso[29:24] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[5] && (push_pos_iso[23:20] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst_iso[35:30] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[6] && (push_pos_iso[27:24] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst_iso[41:36] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[7] && (push_pos_iso[31:28] == gfl[3:0])) ? slot_pdst_iso[47:42] :
                (do_alloc && alloc_push_en && (free_tail == gfl[3:0]))          ? alloc_push_data        :
                                                                                  free_list[6*gfl +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar gs;
    generate
        for (gs = 0; gs < 8; gs = gs + 1) begin : gen_slot
            assign slot_pdst_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? pdst_new :
                                                             slot_pdst[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_old_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? old_prd :
                                                             slot_old[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_rd_nxt[5*gs +: 5] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? 5'd0 :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs[2:0])) ? id_rd :
                                                             slot_rd[5*gs +: 5];
        end
    endgenerate

    assign ready_set = (alu_complete_valid  ? (48'd1 << alu_complete_prd)  : 48'd0) |
                       (load_complete_valid ? (48'd1 << load_complete_prd) : 48'd0);
    assign ready_clr = (do_alloc && need_pr) ? (48'd1 << rd_prd) : 48'd0;
    assign ready_nxt = (ready_tbl | ready_set) & ~ready_clr;

    assign free_head_nxt  = free_head + ((do_alloc && need_pr) ? 4'd1 : 4'd0);
    assign free_tail_nxt  = free_tail + ((do_alloc && alloc_push_en) ? 4'd1 :
                                         (do_flush && (|flush_push_count)) ? flush_push_count :
                                         4'd0);
    assign free_count_nxt = free_count +
                            ((do_alloc && alloc_push_en) ? 5'd1 : 5'd0) +
                            ((do_flush && (|flush_push_count)) ? {1'b0, flush_push_count} : 5'd0) -
                            ((do_alloc && need_pr) ? 5'd1 : 5'd0);
    assign cur_tail_nxt   = do_flush ? flush_next4 :
                            do_alloc ? (rob_alloc_index + 4'd1) : cur_tail;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Write enables: wide state is only rewritten when its value can
    // actually change, cutting unconditional per-cycle toggling.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic spec_map_en;
    logic free_list_en;
    logic free_head_en;
    logic free_tail_en;
    logic free_count_en;
    logic ready_en;
    logic slot_en;
    logic cur_tail_en;

    assign spec_map_en   = (do_alloc && need_pr) || (do_flush && (|slot_win));
    assign free_list_en  = (do_alloc && alloc_push_en) || (do_flush && (|flush_push_count));
    assign free_head_en  = do_alloc && need_pr;
    assign free_tail_en  = (do_alloc && alloc_push_en) || (do_flush && (|flush_push_count));
    assign free_count_en = (do_alloc && (alloc_push_en || need_pr)) ||
                           (do_flush && (|flush_push_count));
    assign ready_en      = (|ready_set) || (|ready_clr);
    assign slot_en       = do_alloc || (|flush_elig);
    assign cur_tail_en   = do_alloc || do_flush;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // State update
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : rename_state
        if (!rst_n) begin
            spec_map   <= SPEC_INIT;
            free_list  <= FREE_INIT;
            free_head  <= 4'd0;
            free_tail  <= 4'd0;
            free_count <= 5'd16;
            ready_tbl  <= {48{1'b1}};
            slot_pdst  <= 48'b0;
            slot_old   <= 48'b0;
            slot_rd    <= 40'b0;
            cur_tail   <= 4'd0;
        end else if (!halted) begin
            if (spec_map_en)   spec_map   <= spec_map_nxt;
            if (free_list_en)  free_list  <= free_list_nxt;
            if (free_head_en)  free_head  <= free_head_nxt;
            if (free_tail_en)  free_tail  <= free_tail_nxt;
            if (free_count_en) free_count <= free_count_nxt;
            if (ready_en)      ready_tbl  <= ready_nxt;
            if (slot_en) begin
                slot_pdst <= slot_pdst_nxt;
                slot_old  <= slot_old_nxt;
                slot_rd   <= slot_rd_nxt;
            end
            if (cur_tail_en)   cur_tail   <= cur_tail_nxt;
        end
    end

endmodule

    assign iq_disp_is_jal         = id_is_jal;
    assign iq_disp_is_jalr        = id_is_jalr;
    assign iq_disp_use_imm        = id_use_imm;
    assign iq_disp_is_auipc       = id_is_auipc;
    assign iq_disp_pred_next_pc   = id_pred_next_pc;
    assign iq_disp_pred_taken     = id_pred_taken;
    assign iq_disp_pred_type      = id_pred_type;

    assign lsu_disp_valid         = do_alloc && is_mem;
    assign lsu_disp_pc            = id_pc;
    assign lsu_disp_insn          = id_insn;
    assign lsu_disp_rob_index     = rob_alloc_index;
    assign lsu_disp_prs1          = rs1_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_prs2          = rs2_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_pdst          = rd_prd;
    assign lsu_disp_rs1_ready     = rs1_rdy;
    assign lsu_disp_rs2_ready     = rs2_rdy;
    assign lsu_disp_imm           = id_imm;
    assign lsu_disp_is_load       = id_is_load;
    assign lsu_disp_is_store      = id_is_store;
    assign lsu_disp_mem_size      = id_mem_size;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Flush / free-list push helpers (constant-index row decode only)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [3:0]  flush_next4;
    logic [3:0]  flush_cnt4;
    logic [7:0]  flush_elig;
    logic [23:0] flush_rank;
    logic [31:0] flush_push_pos;
    logic [3:0]  flush_push_count;
    logic        alloc_push_en;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_push_data;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_slot_pdst;
    logic [5:0]  alloc_slot_old;

    assign flush_next4 = flush_rob_index + 4'd1;
    assign flush_cnt4  = cur_tail - flush_next4;

    // One 3-bit circular distance per checkpoint row (row sums are
    // written with explicit constant row indices).
    logic [23:0] slot_dist;
    assign slot_dist[2:0]   = 3'd0 - flush_next4[2:0];
    assign slot_dist[5:3]   = 3'd1 - flush_next4[2:0];
    assign slot_dist[8:6]   = 3'd2 - flush_next4[2:0];
    assign slot_dist[11:9]  = 3'd3 - flush_next4[2:0];
    assign slot_dist[14:12] = 3'd4 - flush_next4[2:0];
    assign slot_dist[17:15] = 3'd5 - flush_next4[2:0];
    assign slot_dist[20:18] = 3'd6 - flush_next4[2:0];
    assign slot_dist[23:21] = 3'd7 - flush_next4[2:0];

    // dist_lt[8*gw + k] = (distance of row k) < (distance of row gw)
    logic [63:0] dist_lt;
    genvar gd;
    generate
        for (gd = 0; gd < 8; gd = gd + 1) begin : gen_dist_lt
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 0] = (slot_dist[2:0]   < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 1] = (slot_dist[5:3]   < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 2] = (slot_dist[8:6]   < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 3] = (slot_dist[11:9]  < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 4] = (slot_dist[14:12] < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 5] = (slot_dist[17:15] < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 6] = (slot_dist[20:18] < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
            assign dist_lt[8*gd + 7] = (slot_dist[23:21] < slot_dist[3*gd +: 3]);
        end
    endgenerate

    assign flush_elig[0] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[0  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[2:0]}   < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[1] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[6  +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[5:3]}   < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[2] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[12 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[8:6]}   < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[3] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[18 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[11:9]}  < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[4] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[24 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[14:12]} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[5] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[30 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[17:15]} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[6] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[36 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[20:18]} < flush_cnt4);
    assign flush_elig[7] = do_flush && (slot_pdst[42 +: 6] != PR_ZERO) && ({1'b0, slot_dist[23:21]} < flush_cnt4);

    assign flush_push_count = {3'd0, flush_elig[0]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[1]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[2]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[3]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[4]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[5]} +
                              {3'd0, flush_elig[6]} + {3'd0, flush_elig[7]};

    genvar gr;
    generate
        for (gr = 0; gr < 8; gr = gr + 1) begin : gen_flush_rank
            assign flush_rank[3*gr +: 3] =
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[0] && dist_lt[8*gr + 0])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[1] && dist_lt[8*gr + 1])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[2] && dist_lt[8*gr + 2])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[3] && dist_lt[8*gr + 3])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[4] && dist_lt[8*gr + 4])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[5] && dist_lt[8*gr + 5])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[6] && dist_lt[8*gr + 6])} +
                {2'b0, (flush_elig[7] && dist_lt[8*gr + 7])};
        end
    endgenerate

    assign flush_push_pos[3:0]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[2:0]};
    assign flush_push_pos[7:4]   = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[5:3]};
    assign flush_push_pos[11:8]  = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[8:6]};
    assign flush_push_pos[15:12] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[11:9]};
    assign flush_push_pos[19:16] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[14:12]};
    assign flush_push_pos[23:20] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[17:15]};
    assign flush_push_pos[27:24] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[20:18]};
    assign flush_push_pos[31:28] = free_tail + {1'b0, flush_rank[23:21]};

    assign alloc_slot_pdst = slot_pdst[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_slot_old  = slot_old[(6*alloc_slot[2:0]) +: 6];
    assign alloc_push_en   = (alloc_slot_pdst != PR_ZERO) && (alloc_slot_old != PR_ZERO);
    assign alloc_push_data = alloc_slot_old;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Restore winner per checkpoint row.  At most one row per
    // architectural register survives (the oldest eligible writer).
    // The row rd inputs are isolated when no flush is active so the
    // restore comparators do not toggle on the rename path.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [39:0] slot_rd_iso;
    logic [7:0]  slot_win;

    assign slot_rd_iso = {40{do_flush}} & slot_rd;

    genvar gw;
    generate
        for (gw = 0; gw < 8; gw = gw + 1) begin : gen_slot_win
            assign slot_win[gw] = flush_elig[gw] &&
                !( (flush_elig[0] && (slot_rd_iso[4:0]   == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 0]) ||
                   (flush_elig[1] && (slot_rd_iso[9:5]   == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 1]) ||
                   (flush_elig[2] && (slot_rd_iso[14:10] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 2]) ||
                   (flush_elig[3] && (slot_rd_iso[19:15] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 3]) ||
                   (flush_elig[4] && (slot_rd_iso[24:20] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 4]) ||
                   (flush_elig[5] && (slot_rd_iso[29:25] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 5]) ||
                   (flush_elig[6] && (slot_rd_iso[34:30] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 6]) ||
                   (flush_elig[7] && (slot_rd_iso[39:35] == slot_rd_iso[5*gw +: 5]) && dist_lt[8*gw + 7]) );
        end
    endgenerate

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Next-state values (all continuous, fully driven, constant rows)
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic [255:0] rd_match;      // rd_match[8*ga + k] = row k writes arch ga
    logic [191:0] spec_map_nxt;
    logic [95:0]  free_list_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_pdst_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  slot_old_nxt;
    logic [39:0]  slot_rd_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_head_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   free_tail_nxt;
    logic [4:0]   free_count_nxt;
    logic [3:0]   cur_tail_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  ready_nxt;
    logic [47:0]  ready_set;
    logic [47:0]  ready_clr;

    genvar ga;
    generate
        for (ga = 0; ga < 32; ga = ga + 1) begin : gen_spec_map
            logic       hit;
            logic [5:0] rval;

            assign rd_match[8*ga + 0] = (slot_rd_iso[4:0]   == ga);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 1] = (slot_rd_iso[9:5]   == ga);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 2] = (slot_rd_iso[14:10] == ga);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 3] = (slot_rd_iso[19:15] == ga);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 4] = (slot_rd_iso[24:20] == ga);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 5] = (slot_rd_iso[29:25] == ga);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 6] = (slot_rd_iso[34:30] == ga);
            assign rd_match[8*ga + 7] = (slot_rd_iso[39:35] == ga);

            assign hit = |(rd_match[8*ga +: 8] & slot_win);

            assign rval =
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 0] & slot_win[0]}} & slot_old[5:0])   |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 1] & slot_win[1]}} & slot_old[11:6])  |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 2] & slot_win[2]}} & slot_old[17:12]) |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 3] & slot_win[3]}} & slot_old[23:18]) |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 4] & slot_win[4]}} & slot_old[29:24]) |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 5] & slot_win[5]}} & slot_old[35:30]) |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 6] & slot_win[6]}} & slot_old[41:36]) |
                ({6{rd_match[8*ga + 7] & slot_win[7]}} & slot_old[47:42]);

            assign spec_map_nxt[6*ga +: 6] =
                (do_alloc && need_pr && (id_rd == ga)) ? rd_prd :
                (do_flush && hit)                      ? rval   :
                                                         spec_map[6*ga +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    // Operand isolation for the free-list push network: the flush push
    // sources are constant zero outside a flush.
    logic [31:0] push_pos_iso;
    logic [47:0] slot_pdst_iso;

    assign push_pos_iso  = {32{do_flush}} & flush_push_pos;
    assign slot_pdst_iso = {48{do_flush}} & slot_pdst;

    genvar gfl;
    generate
        for (gfl = 0; gfl < 16; gfl = gfl + 1) begin : gen_free_list
            assign free_list_nxt[6*gfl +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[0] && (push_pos_iso[3:0]   == gfl)) ? slot_pdst_iso[5:0]   :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[1] && (push_pos_iso[7:4]   == gfl)) ? slot_pdst_iso[11:6]  :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[2] && (push_pos_iso[11:8]  == gfl)) ? slot_pdst_iso[17:12] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[3] && (push_pos_iso[15:12] == gfl)) ? slot_pdst_iso[23:18] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[4] && (push_pos_iso[19:16] == gfl)) ? slot_pdst_iso[29:24] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[5] && (push_pos_iso[23:20] == gfl)) ? slot_pdst_iso[35:30] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[6] && (push_pos_iso[27:24] == gfl)) ? slot_pdst_iso[41:36] :
                (do_flush && flush_elig[7] && (push_pos_iso[31:28] == gfl)) ? slot_pdst_iso[47:42] :
                (do_alloc && alloc_push_en && (free_tail == gfl))          ? alloc_push_data        :
                                                                              free_list[6*gfl +: 6];
        end
    endgenerate

    genvar gs;
    generate
        for (gs = 0; gs < 8; gs = gs + 1) begin : gen_slot
            assign slot_pdst_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs))      ? pdst_new :
                                                             slot_pdst[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_old_nxt[6*gs +: 6] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? PR_ZERO :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs))      ? old_prd :
                                                             slot_old[6*gs +: 6];

            assign slot_rd_nxt[5*gs +: 5] =
                (do_flush && flush_elig[gs])               ? 5'd0 :
                (do_alloc && (alloc_slot[2:0] == gs))      ? id_rd :
                                                             slot_rd[5*gs +: 5];
        end
    endgenerate

    assign ready_set = (alu_complete_valid  ? (48'd1 << alu_complete_prd)  : 48'd0) |
                       (load_complete_valid ? (48'd1 << load_complete_prd) : 48'd0);
    assign ready_clr = (do_alloc && need_pr) ? (48'd1 << rd_prd) : 48'd0;
    assign ready_nxt = (ready_tbl | ready_set) & ~ready_clr;

    assign free_head_nxt  = free_head + ((do_alloc && need_pr) ? 4'd1 : 4'd0);
    assign free_tail_nxt  = free_tail + ((do_alloc && alloc_push_en) ? 4'd1 :
                                         (do_flush && (|flush_push_count)) ? flush_push_count :
                                         4'd0);
    assign free_count_nxt = free_count +
                            ((do_alloc && alloc_push_en) ? 5'd1 : 5'd0) +
                            ((do_flush && (|flush_push_count)) ? {1'b0, flush_push_count} : 5'd0) -
                            ((do_alloc && need_pr) ? 5'd1 : 5'd0);
    assign cur_tail_nxt   = do_flush ? flush_next4 :
                            do_alloc ? (rob_alloc_index + 4'd1) : cur_tail;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // Write enables: wide state is only rewritten when its value can
    // actually change, cutting unconditional per-cycle toggling.
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    logic spec_map_en;
    logic free_list_en;
    logic free_head_en;
    logic free_tail_en;
    logic free_count_en;
    logic ready_en;
    logic slot_en;
    logic cur_tail_en;

    assign spec_map_en   = (do_alloc && need_pr) || (do_flush && (|slot_win));
    assign free_list_en  = (do_alloc && alloc_push_en) || (do_flush && (|flush_push_count));
    assign free_head_en  = do_alloc && need_pr;
    assign free_tail_en  = (do_alloc && alloc_push_en) || (do_flush && (|flush_push_count));
    assign free_count_en = (do_alloc && (alloc_push_en || need_pr)) ||
                           (do_flush && (|flush_push_count));
    assign ready_en      = (|ready_set) || (|ready_clr);
    assign slot_en       = do_alloc || (|flush_elig);
    assign cur_tail_en   = do_alloc || do_flush;

    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    // State update
    // -----------------------------------------------------------------
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : rename_state
        if (!rst_n) begin
            spec_map   <= SPEC_INIT;
            free_list  <= FREE_INIT;
            free_head  <= 4'd0;
            free_tail  <= 4'd0;
            free_count <= 5'd16;
            ready_tbl  <= {48{1'b1}};
            slot_pdst  <= 48'b0;
            slot_old   <= 48'b0;
            slot_rd    <= 40'b0;
            cur_tail   <= 4'd0;
        end else if (!halted) begin
            if (spec_map_en)   spec_map   <= spec_map_nxt;
            if (free_list_en)  free_list  <= free_list_nxt;
            if (free_head_en)  free_head  <= free_head_nxt;
            if (free_tail_en)  free_tail  <= free_tail_nxt;
            if (free_count_en) free_count <= free_count_nxt;
            if (ready_en)      ready_tbl  <= ready_nxt;
            if (slot_en) begin
                slot_pdst <= slot_pdst_nxt;
                slot_old  <= slot_old_nxt;
                slot_rd   <= slot_rd_nxt;
            end
            if (cur_tail_en)   cur_tail   <= cur_tail_nxt;
        end
    end

endmodule
",
  "rtl/dcache.sv": "module dcache (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic [1:0]  flush_epoch,
    input  logic [3:0]  flush_rob_index,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        cpu_req_valid,
    input  logic        cpu_req_we,
    input  logic [31:0] cpu_req_addr,
    input  logic [31:0] cpu_req_wdata,
    input  logic [3:0]  cpu_req_be,
    input  logic [3:0]  cpu_req_rob_index,
    input  logic [1:0]  cpu_req_epoch,
    output logic        cpu_req_ready,
    output logic        cpu_resp_valid,
    output logic [31:0] cpu_resp_rdata,
    output logic [1:0]  cpu_resp_epoch,
    output logic        mem_req_valid,
    input  logic        mem_req_ready,
    output logic        mem_req_we,
    output logic [31:0] mem_req_addr,
    output logic [31:0] mem_req_wdata,
    output logic [3:0]  mem_req_be,
    input  logic        mem_resp_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] mem_resp_data,
    output logic        dcache_mem_wait,
    output logic        idle
);

    localparam logic [2:0] ST_IDLE  = 3'd0;
    localparam logic [2:0] ST_REFILL= 3'd1;
    localparam logic [2:0] ST_WT    = 3'd2;
    localparam logic [2:0] ST_RESP  = 3'd3;

    logic [2:0]  state;
    logic [127:0] line_data [0:3];
    logic [25:0]  line_tag  [0:3];
    logic [3:0]   line_valid;

    logic [31:0] req_addr;
    logic [31:0] req_wdata;
    logic [3:0]  req_be;
    logic        req_we;
    logic [3:0]  req_rob;
    logic [1:0]  req_epoch;

    logic [31:0] refill_base;
    logic [1:0]  refill_word;
    logic [127:0] refill_data;
    logic [127:0] refill_data_next;
    logic [25:0] refill_tag;
    logic [1:0]  refill_idx;

    logic [31:0] wt_addr;
    logic [31:0] wt_wdata;
    logic [3:0]  wt_be;

    logic [31:0] resp_rdata;
    logic [1:0]  resp_epoch;

    logic [31:0] lookup_addr;
    logic [1:0]  idx;
    logic [25:0] tag;
    logic [1:0]  wsel;
    logic        hit;
    logic [127:0] hit_line;
    logic [31:0] hit_word;
    logic [31:0] be_mask;
    logic [31:0] merged_word;

    assign lookup_addr = (state == ST_IDLE) ? cpu_req_addr : req_addr;
    assign idx  = lookup_addr[5:4];
    assign tag  = lookup_addr[31:6];
    assign wsel = lookup_addr[3:2];
    assign hit  = line_valid[idx] && (line_tag[idx] == tag);
    assign hit_line = line_data[idx];

    always_comb begin
        case (wsel)
            2'd0:    hit_word = hit_line[31:0];
            2'd1:    hit_word = hit_line[63:32];
            2'd2:    hit_word = hit_line[95:64];
            default: hit_word = hit_line[127:96];
        endcase
    end

    assign be_mask = {{8{cpu_req_be[3]}}, {8{cpu_req_be[2]}}, {8{cpu_req_be[1]}}, {8{cpu_req_be[0]}}};
    assign merged_word = (hit_word & ~be_mask) | (cpu_req_wdata & be_mask);

    assign cpu_req_ready = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !halted;

    assign mem_req_valid = rst_n && ((state == ST_REFILL) || (state == ST_WT));
    assign mem_req_we    = (state == ST_WT);
    assign mem_req_addr  = (state == ST_WT) ? wt_addr : (refill_base + {refill_word, 2'b00});
    assign mem_req_wdata = (state == ST_WT) ? wt_wdata : 32'b0;
    assign mem_req_be    = (state == ST_WT) ? wt_be : 4'b1111;

    assign dcache_mem_wait = mem_req_valid && !mem_req_ready;
    assign idle = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !cpu_req_valid;

    assign cpu_resp_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_RESP);
    assign cpu_resp_rdata = resp_rdata;
    assign cpu_resp_epoch = resp_epoch;

    always_comb begin
        refill_data_next = refill_data;
        if ((state == ST_REFILL) && mem_req_ready) begin
            case (refill_word)
                2'd0: refill_data_next[31:0]   = mem_resp_data;
                2'd1: refill_data_next[63:32]  = mem_resp_data;
                2'd2: refill_data_next[95:64]  = mem_resp_data;
                2'd3: refill_data_next[127:96] = mem_resp_data;
                default: refill_data_next = refill_data;
            endcase
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : dcache_state
        integer r;
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state       <= ST_IDLE;
            line_valid  <= 4'b0;
            req_addr    <= 32'b0;
            req_wdata   <= 32'b0;
            req_be      <= 4'b0;
            req_we      <= 1'b0;
            req_rob     <= 4'b0;
            req_epoch   <= 2'b0;
            refill_base <= 32'b0;
            refill_word <= 2'b0;
            refill_data <= 128'b0;
            refill_tag  <= 26'b0;
            refill_idx  <= 2'b0;
            wt_addr     <= 32'b0;
            wt_wdata    <= 32'b0;
            wt_be       <= 4'b0;
            resp_rdata  <= 32'b0;
            resp_epoch  <= 2'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                ST_IDLE: begin
                    if (cpu_req_valid && cpu_req_ready) begin
                        req_addr  <= cpu_req_addr;
                        req_wdata <= cpu_req_wdata;
                        req_be    <= cpu_req_be;
                        req_we    <= cpu_req_we;
                        req_rob   <= cpu_req_rob_index;
                        req_epoch <= cpu_req_epoch;
                        if (cpu_req_we) begin
                            if (hit) begin
                                for (r = 0; r < 4; r = r + 1) begin
                                    if (idx == r[1:0]) begin
                                        case (wsel)
                                            2'd0: line_data[r][31:0]    <= merged_word;
                                            2'd1: line_data[r][63:32]   <= merged_word;
                                            2'd2: line_data[r][95:64]   <= merged_word;
                                            default: line_data[r][127:96] <= merged_word;
                                        endcase
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            wt_addr  <= cpu_req_addr;
                            wt_wdata <= cpu_req_wdata;
                            wt_be    <= cpu_req_be;
                            state    <= ST_WT;
                        end else if (hit) begin
                            resp_rdata <= hit_word;
                            resp_epoch <= cpu_req_epoch;
                            state      <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_base <= {cpu_req_addr[31:4], 4'b0000};
                            refill_tag  <= cpu_req_addr[31:6];
                            refill_idx  <= cpu_req_addr[5:4];
                            refill_word <= 2'b0;
                            refill_data <= 128'b0;
                            state       <= ST_REFILL;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_REFILL: begin
                    if (mem_req_ready) begin
                        if (refill_word == 2'b11) begin
                            for (r = 0; r < 4; r = r + 1) begin
                                if (refill_idx == r[1:0]) begin
                                    line_data[r]  <= refill_data_next;
                                    line_tag[r]   <= refill_tag;
                                    line_valid[r] <= 1'b1;
                                end
                            end
                            case (wsel)
                                2'd0:    resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[31:0];
                                2'd1:    resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[63:32];
                                2'd2:    resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[95:64];
                                default: resp_rdata <= refill_data_next[127:96];
                            endcase
                            resp_epoch <= req_epoch;
                            state      <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_data <= refill_data_next;
                            refill_word <= refill_word + 2'b01;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_WT: begin
                    if (mem_req_ready) begin
                        resp_rdata <= 32'b0;
                        resp_epoch <= req_epoch;
                        state      <= ST_RESP;
                    end
                end
                ST_RESP: begin
                    state <= ST_IDLE;
                end
                default: state <= ST_IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
",
  "rtl/icache.sv": "module icache (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic [1:0]  flush_epoch,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        cpu_req_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] cpu_req_addr,
    input  logic [1:0]  cpu_req_epoch,
    output logic        cpu_req_ready,
    output logic        cpu_resp_valid,
    output logic [31:0] cpu_resp_data,
    output logic [1:0]  cpu_resp_epoch,
    output logic        mem_req_valid,
    input  logic        mem_req_ready,
    output logic [31:0] mem_req_addr,
    input  logic        mem_resp_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] mem_resp_data,
    output logic        idle
);

    localparam logic [1:0] ST_IDLE   = 2'd0;
    localparam logic [1:0] ST_REFILL = 2'd1;
    localparam logic [1:0] ST_RESP   = 2'd2;

    logic [1:0]   state;

    logic [127:0] line_data  [0:3];
    logic [25:0]  line_tag   [0:3];
    logic [3:0]   line_valid;

    logic [31:0] req_addr;
    logic [1:0]  req_epoch;

    logic [31:0]  refill_base;
    logic [1:0]   refill_word;
    logic [127:0] refill_data;
    logic [127:0] refill_next;
    logic [25:0]  refill_tag;
    logic [1:0]   refill_idx;

    logic [31:0] resp_data_r;
    logic [1:0]  resp_epoch_r;

    logic [1:0]  cpu_idx;
    logic [25:0] cpu_tag;
    logic [1:0]  cpu_wsel;
    logic        cpu_hit;
    logic [31:0] cpu_word;
    logic [127:0] cpu_line;

    logic [1:0]  ref_wsel;
    logic [31:0] ref_word;

    assign cpu_idx  = cpu_req_addr[5:4];
    assign cpu_tag  = cpu_req_addr[31:6];
    assign cpu_wsel = cpu_req_addr[3:2];

    always_comb begin
        cpu_line = line_data[cpu_idx];
        cpu_hit  = line_valid[cpu_idx] && (line_tag[cpu_idx] == cpu_tag);
        case (cpu_wsel)
            2'd0:    cpu_word = cpu_line[31:0];
            2'd1:    cpu_word = cpu_line[63:32];
            2'd2:    cpu_word = cpu_line[95:64];
            default: cpu_word = cpu_line[127:96];
        endcase
    end

    assign ref_wsel = req_addr[3:2];
    always_comb begin
        case (ref_wsel)
            2'd0:    ref_word = refill_next[31:0];
            2'd1:    ref_word = refill_next[63:32];
            2'd2:    ref_word = refill_next[95:64];
            default: ref_word = refill_next[127:96];
        endcase
    end

    always_comb begin
        refill_next = refill_data;
        case (refill_word)
            2'd0:    refill_next[31:0]    = mem_resp_data;
            2'd1:    refill_next[63:32]   = mem_resp_data;
            2'd2:    refill_next[95:64]   = mem_resp_data;
            default: refill_next[127:96]  = mem_resp_data;
        endcase
    end

    assign cpu_req_ready  = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !halted;

    assign cpu_resp_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_RESP);
    assign cpu_resp_data  = resp_data_r;
    assign cpu_resp_epoch = resp_epoch_r;

    assign mem_req_valid = rst_n && (state == ST_REFILL);
    assign mem_req_addr  = refill_base + {refill_word, 2'b00};

    assign idle = rst_n && (state == ST_IDLE) && !cpu_req_valid;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin : icache_state
        integer r;
        if (!rst_n) begin
            state        <= ST_IDLE;
            line_valid   <= 4'b0;
            req_addr     <= 32'b0;
            req_epoch    <= 2'b0;
            refill_base  <= 32'b0;
            refill_word  <= 2'b0;
            refill_data  <= 128'b0;
            refill_tag   <= 26'b0;
            refill_idx   <= 2'b0;
            resp_data_r  <= 32'b0;
            resp_epoch_r <= 2'b0;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                ST_IDLE: begin
                    if (cpu_req_valid && !halted) begin
                        req_addr  <= cpu_req_addr;
                        req_epoch <= cpu_req_epoch;
                        if (cpu_hit) begin
                            resp_data_r  <= cpu_word;
                            resp_epoch_r <= cpu_req_epoch;
                            state        <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_base <= {cpu_req_addr[31:4], 4'b0000};
                            refill_tag  <= cpu_req_addr[31:6];
                            refill_idx  <= cpu_req_addr[5:4];
                            refill_word <= 2'b00;
                            refill_data <= 128'b0;
                            state       <= ST_REFILL;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_REFILL: begin
                    if (mem_req_ready && mem_resp_valid) begin
                        refill_data <= refill_next;
                        if (refill_word == 2'b11) begin
                            for (r = 0; r < 4; r = r + 1) begin
                                if (refill_idx == r[1:0]) begin
                                    line_data[r]  <= refill_next;
                                    line_tag[r]   <= refill_tag;
                                    line_valid[r] <= 1'b1;
                                end
                            end
                            resp_data_r  <= ref_word;
                            resp_epoch_r <= req_epoch;
                            state        <= ST_RESP;
                        end else begin
                            refill_word <= refill_word + 2'b01;
                        end
                    end
                end
                ST_RESP: begin
                    state <= ST_IDLE;
                end
                default: state <= ST_IDLE;
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
",
  "rtl/issue_queue.sv": "module issue_queue (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic [3:0]  flush_rob_index,
    input  logic [3:0]  rob_head_index,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        iq_disp_valid,
    output logic        iq_disp_ready,
    input  logic [31:0] iq_disp_pc,
    input  logic [31:0] iq_disp_insn,
    input  logic [3:0]  iq_disp_rob_index,
    input  logic [5:0]  iq_disp_prs1,
    input  logic [5:0]  iq_disp_prs2,
    input  logic [5:0]  iq_disp_pdst,
    input  logic        iq_disp_rs1_ready,
    input  logic        iq_disp_rs2_ready,
    input  logic [31:0] iq_disp_imm,
    input  logic [4:0]  iq_disp_alu_op,
    input  logic [2:0]  iq_disp_wb_sel,
    input  logic        iq_disp_is_branch,
    input  logic        iq_disp_is_jal,
    input  logic        iq_disp_is_jalr,
    input  logic        iq_disp_use_imm,
    input  logic        iq_disp_is_auipc,
    input  logic [31:0] iq_disp_pred_next_pc,
    input  logic        iq_disp_pred_taken,
    input  logic [1:0]  iq_disp_pred_type,
    input  logic        alu_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  alu_complete_prd,
    input  logic        load_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  load_complete_prd,
    output logic [5:0]  iq_prf_rs1_addr,
    output logic [5:0]  iq_prf_rs2_addr,
    input  logic [31:0] iq_prf_rdata1,
    input  logic [31:0] iq_prf_rdata2,
    output logic        issue_valid,
    input  logic        issue_ready,
    output logic [31:0] issue_pc,
    output logic [31:0] issue_insn,
    output logic [3:0]  issue_rob_index,
    output logic [5:0]  issue_prs1,
    output logic [5:0]  issue_prs2,
    output logic [5:0]  issue_pdst,
    output logic [31:0] issue_operand1,
    output logic [31:0] issue_operand2,
    output logic [31:0] issue_imm,
    output logic [4:0]  issue_alu_op,
    output logic [2:0]  issue_wb_sel,
    output logic        issue_is_branch,
    output logic        issue_is_jal,
    output logic        issue_is_jalr,
    output logic        issue_use_imm,
    output logic        issue_is_auipc,
    output logic [31:0] issue_pred_next_pc,
    output logic        issue_pred_taken,
    output logic [1:0]  issue_pred_type,
    output logic        dbg_ooo_issue,
    output logic        dbg_ooo_bypass
);

    localparam int IQ_DEPTH = 8;

    logic        ent_valid   [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [31:0] ent_pc      [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [31:0] ent_insn    [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [3:0]  ent_rob     [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_prs1    [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_prs2    [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_pdst    [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_r1rdy   [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_r2rdy   [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [4:0]  ent_alu_op  [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [2:0]  ent_wb_sel  [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_br      [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_jal     [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_jalr    [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_useimm  [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_auipc   [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [31:0] ent_prednpc [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic        ent_predtk  [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];
    logic [1:0]  ent_predty  [0:IQ_DEPTH-1];

    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] ent_ready;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] ent_sel;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] ent_uses1;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] ent_uses2;

    logic        free_exist;
    logic [2:0]  free_idx;
    logic        sel_exist;
    logic [2:0]  sel_idx;
    logic        disp_fire;
    logic        issue_fire;
    logic        bypass_fire;
    logic        disp_uses1;
    logic        disp_uses2;

    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] flush_mask;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] valid_next;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] r1rdy_next;
    logic [IQ_DEPTH-1:0] r2rdy_next;

    logic [31:0] sel_insn;
    logic [31:0] issue_imm_c;

    integer fi;
    integer rei;
    integer si;
    integer sei;
    integer fmi;
    integer rni;
    integer vni;
    integer rsti;
    integer dsi;

    always_comb begin
        free_exist = 1'b0;
        free_idx   = 3'd0;
        for (fi = 0; fi < IQ_DEPTH; fi = fi + 1) begin
            if (!ent_valid[fi] && !free_exist) begin
                free_exist = 1'b1;
                free_idx   = fi[2:0];
            end
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        for (rei = 0; rei < IQ_DEPTH; rei = rei + 1) begin
            ent_uses1[rei] = ent_br[rei] || ent_jalr[rei] ||
                             (!ent_jal[rei] && !ent_auipc[rei] &&
                              !(ent_useimm[rei] && (ent_wb_sel[rei] == 3'b011)));
            ent_uses2[rei] = ent_br[rei] ||
                             (!ent_useimm[rei] && !ent_jal[rei] &&
                              !ent_jalr[rei] && !ent_auipc[rei]);
        end
    end

    assign disp_uses1 = iq_disp_is_branch || iq_disp_is_jalr ||
                        (!iq_disp_is_jal && !iq_disp_is_auipc &&
                         !(iq_disp_use_imm && (iq_disp_wb_sel == 3'b011)));
    assign disp_uses2 = iq_disp_is_branch ||
                        (!iq_disp_use_imm && !iq_disp_is_jal &&
                         !iq_disp_is_jalr && !iq_disp_is_auipc);

    always_comb begin
        for (rei = 0; rei < IQ_DEPTH; rei = rei + 1) begin
            ent_ready[rei] = ent_valid[rei] &&
                             (!ent_uses1[rei] || (ent_prs1[rei] == 6'd0) || ent_r1rdy[rei]) &&
                             (!ent_uses2[rei] || (ent_prs2[rei] == 6'd0) || ent_r2rdy[rei]);
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        sel_exist = 1'b0;
        sel_idx   = 3'd0;
        for (si = 0; si < IQ_DEPTH; si = si + 1) begin
            if (ent_ready[si] && !sel_exist) begin
                sel_exist = 1'b1;
                sel_idx   = si[2:0];
            end
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        for (sei = 0; sei < IQ_DEPTH; sei = sei + 1) begin
            ent_sel[sei] = sel_exist && (sel_idx == sei[2:0]);
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        flush_mask = '0;
        for (fmi = 0; fmi < IQ_DEPTH; fmi = fmi + 1) begin
            if (flush && ent_valid[fmi]) begin
                if ((ent_rob[fmi] - rob_head_index) >=
                    (flush_rob_index - rob_head_index)) begin
                    flush_mask[fmi] = 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        for (rni = 0; rni < IQ_DEPTH; rni = rni + 1) begin
            r1rdy_next[rni] = (ent_prs1[rni] == 6'd0) ? 1'b1 : ent_r1rdy[rni];
            r2rdy_next[rni] = (ent_prs2[rni] == 6'd0) ? 1'b1 : ent_r2rdy[rni];
            if (ent_valid[rni]) begin
                if (alu_complete_valid && (ent_prs1[rni] == alu_complete_prd) && (ent_prs1[rni] != 6'd0)) begin
                    r1rdy_next[rni] = 1'b1;
                end
                if (load_complete_valid && (ent_prs1[rni] == load_complete_prd) && (ent_prs1[rni] != 6'd0)) begin
                    r1rdy_next[rni] = 1'b1;
                end
                if (alu_complete_valid && (ent_prs2[rni] == alu_complete_prd) && (ent_prs2[rni] != 6'd0)) begin
                    r2rdy_next[rni] = 1'b1;
                end
                if (load_complete_valid && (ent_prs2[rni] == load_complete_prd) && (ent_prs2[rni] != 6'd0)) begin
                    r2rdy_next[rni] = 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end
    end

    always_comb begin
        for (vni = 0; vni < IQ_DEPTH; vni = vni + 1) begin
            valid_next[vni] = ent_valid[vni];
            if (flush_mask[vni]) begin
                valid_next[vni] = 1'b0;
            end
            if (issue_fire && (sel_idx == vni[2:0])) begin
                valid_next[vni] = 1'b0;
            end
            if (disp_fire && (free_idx == vni[2:0])) begin
                valid_next[vni] = 1'b1;
            end
        end
    end

    assign disp_fire  = iq_disp_valid && iq_disp_ready && !halted;
    assign issue_fire = issue_valid && issue_ready && !halted;
    assign bypass_fire = issue_fire && (ent_rob[sel_idx] != rob_head_index);

    assign iq_disp_ready = free_exist && !halted && !flush;
    assign issue_valid = sel_exist && !halted && !flush;

    assign sel_insn = ent_insn[sel_idx];

    always_comb begin
        case (sel_insn[6:0])
            7'b0010011, 7'b0000011, 7'b1100111:
                issue_imm_c = {{20{sel_insn[31]}}, sel_insn[31:20]};
            7'b0100011:
                issue_imm_c = {{20{sel_insn[31]}}, sel_insn[31:25], sel_insn[11:7]};
            7'b1100011:
                issue_imm_c = {{19{sel_insn[31]}}, sel_insn[31], sel_insn[7],
                               sel_insn[30:25], sel_insn[11:8], 1'b0};
            7'b0110111, 7'b0010111:
                issue_imm_c = {sel_insn[31:12], 12'b0};
            7'b1101111:
                issue_imm_c = {{11{sel_insn[31]}}, sel_insn[31], sel_insn[19:12],
                               sel_insn[20], sel_insn[30:21], 1'b0};
            default:
                issue_imm_c = 32'b0;
        endcase
    end

    assign issue_pc          = ent_pc[sel_idx];
    assign issue_insn        = ent_insn[sel_idx];
    assign issue_rob_index   = ent_rob[sel_idx];
    assign issue_prs1        = ent_prs1[sel_idx];
    assign issue_prs2        = ent_prs2[sel_idx];
    assign issue_pdst        = ent_pdst[sel_idx];
    assign issue_operand1    = iq_prf_rdata1;
    assign issue_operand2    = iq_prf_rdata2;
    assign issue_imm         = issue_imm_c;
    assign issue_alu_op      = ent_alu_op[sel_idx];
    assign issue_wb_sel      = ent_wb_sel[sel_idx];
    assign issue_is_branch   = ent_br[sel_idx];
    assign issue_is_jal      = ent_jal[sel_idx];
    assign issue_is_jalr     = ent_jalr[sel_idx];
    assign issue_use_imm     = ent_useimm[sel_idx];
    assign issue_is_auipc    = ent_auipc[sel_idx];
    assign issue_pred_next_pc= ent_prednpc[sel_idx];
    assign issue_pred_taken  = ent_predtk[sel_idx];
    assign issue_pred_type   = ent_predty[sel_idx];

    assign iq_prf_rs1_addr = ent_prs1[sel_idx];
    assign iq_prf_rs2_addr = ent_prs2[sel_idx];

    assign dbg_ooo_issue  = issue_fire;
    assign dbg_ooo_bypass = bypass_fire;

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            for (rsti = 0; rsti < IQ_DEPTH; rsti = rsti + 1) begin
                ent_valid[rsti]   <= 1'b0;
                ent_pc[rsti]      <= 32'd0;
                ent_insn[rsti]    <= 32'd0;
                ent_rob[rsti]     <= 4'd0;
                ent_prs1[rsti]    <= 6'd0;
                ent_prs2[rsti]    <= 6'd0;
                ent_pdst[rsti]    <= 6'd0;
                ent_r1rdy[rsti]   <= 1'b0;
                ent_r2rdy[rsti]   <= 1'b0;
                ent_alu_op[rsti]  <= 5'd0;
                ent_wb_sel[rsti]  <= 3'd0;
                ent_br[rsti]      <= 1'b0;
                ent_jal[rsti]     <= 1'b0;
                ent_jalr[rsti]    <= 1'b0;
                ent_useimm[rsti]  <= 1'b0;
                ent_auipc[rsti]   <= 1'b0;
                ent_prednpc[rsti] <= 32'd0;
                ent_predtk[rsti]  <= 1'b0;
                ent_predty[rsti]  <= 2'd0;
            end
        end else begin
            for (rsti = 0; rsti < IQ_DEPTH; rsti = rsti + 1) begin
                ent_valid[rsti] <= valid_next[rsti];
                if (valid_next[rsti]) begin
                    ent_r1rdy[rsti] <= r1rdy_next[rsti];
                    ent_r2rdy[rsti] <= r2rdy_next[rsti];
                end else begin
                    ent_r1rdy[rsti] <= 1'b0;
                    ent_r2rdy[rsti] <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
            if (disp_fire) begin
                for (dsi = 0; dsi < IQ_DEPTH; dsi = dsi + 1) begin
                    if (free_idx == dsi[2:0]) begin
                        ent_pc[dsi]      <= iq_disp_pc;
                        ent_insn[dsi]    <= iq_disp_insn;
                        ent_rob[dsi]     <= iq_disp_rob_index;
                        ent_prs1[dsi]    <= iq_disp_prs1;
                        ent_prs2[dsi]    <= iq_disp_prs2;
                        ent_pdst[dsi]    <= iq_disp_pdst;
                        ent_r1rdy[dsi]   <= !disp_uses1 || (iq_disp_prs1 == 6'd0) || iq_disp_rs1_ready ||
                                             (alu_complete_valid && (iq_disp_prs1 == alu_complete_prd) && (iq_disp_prs1 != 6'd0)) ||
                                             (load_complete_valid && (iq_disp_prs1 == load_complete_prd) && (iq_disp_prs1 != 6'd0));
                        ent_r2rdy[dsi]   <= !disp_uses2 || (iq_disp_prs2 == 6'd0) || iq_disp_rs2_ready ||
                                             (alu_complete_valid && (iq_disp_prs2 == alu_complete_prd) && (iq_disp_prs2 != 6'd0)) ||
                                             (load_complete_valid && (iq_disp_prs2 == load_complete_prd) && (iq_disp_prs2 != 6'd0));
                        ent_alu_op[dsi]  <= iq_disp_alu_op;
                        ent_wb_sel[dsi]  <= iq_disp_wb_sel;
                        ent_br[dsi]      <= iq_disp_is_branch;
                        ent_jal[dsi]     <= iq_disp_is_jal;
                        ent_jalr[dsi]    <= iq_disp_is_jalr;
                        ent_useimm[dsi]  <= iq_disp_use_imm;
                        ent_auipc[dsi]   <= iq_disp_is_auipc;
                        ent_prednpc[dsi] <= iq_disp_pred_next_pc;
                        ent_predtk[dsi]  <= iq_disp_pred_taken;
                        ent_predty[dsi]  <= iq_disp_pred_type;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
",
  "rtl/load_store_unit.sv": "module load_store_unit (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        flush,
    input  logic [3:0]  flush_rob_index,
    input  logic [1:0]  flush_epoch,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_valid,
    output logic        lsu_disp_ready,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_disp_pc,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_disp_insn,
    input  logic [3:0]  lsu_disp_rob_index,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_disp_prs1,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_disp_prs2,
    input  logic [5:0]  lsu_disp_pdst,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_rs1_ready,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_rs2_ready,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_disp_imm,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_is_load,
    input  logic        lsu_disp_is_store,
    input  logic [1:0]  lsu_disp_mem_size,
    input  logic        alu_complete_valid,
    input  logic [5:0]  alu_complete_prd,
    output logic [5:0]  lsu_prf_rs1_addr,
    output logic [5:0]  lsu_prf_rs2_addr,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_prf_rdata1,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_prf_rdata2,
    input  logic        store_commit_valid,
    input  logic [3:0]  store_commit_rob_index,
    output logic        store_done_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  store_done_rob_index,
    output logic        load_complete_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  load_complete_rob_index,
    output logic [5:0]  load_complete_prd,
    output logic [31:0] load_complete_data,
    output logic        lsu_dcache_req_valid,
    output logic        lsu_dcache_req_we,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_dcache_req_addr,
    output logic [31:0] lsu_dcache_req_wdata,
    output logic [3:0]  lsu_dcache_req_be,
    output logic [3:0]  lsu_dcache_req_rob_index,
    output logic [1:0]  lsu_dcache_req_epoch,
    input  logic        lsu_dcache_req_ready,
    input  logic        lsu_dcache_resp_valid,
    input  logic [31:0] lsu_dcache_resp_rdata,
    input  logic [1:0]  lsu_dcache_resp_epoch,
    output logic        lsu_dcache_wait,
    output logic        lsu_idle
);

    localparam logic [1:0] MEM_BYTE = 2'b00;
    localparam logic [1:0] MEM_HALF = 2'b01;

    logic        ent_valid     [0:1];
    logic [31:0] ent_insn      [0:1];
    logic [3:0]  ent_rob       [0:1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_prs1      [0:1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_prs2      [0:1];
    logic [5:0]  ent_pdst      [0:1];
    logic        ent_rs1_ready [0:1];
    logic        ent_rs2_ready [0:1];
    logic        ent_is_load   [0:1];
    logic        ent_is_store  [0:1];
    logic [1:0]  ent_epoch     [0:1];
    logic        ent_issued    [0:1];
    logic        ent_committed [0:1];

    logic        req_active;
    logic        req_we_q;
    logic [31:0] req_addr_q;
    logic [31:0] req_wdata_q;
    logic [3:0]  req_be_q;
    logic [3:0]  req_rob_q;
    logic [1:0]  req_epoch_q;

    logic        head_valid;
    logic        tail_valid;
    logic        head_rs1_wake;
    logic        head_rs2_wake;
    logic        tail_rs1_wake;
    logic        tail_rs2_wake;
    logic        tail_rs1_ready_eff;
    logic        tail_rs2_ready_eff;
    logic        head_rs1_ok;
    logic        head_rs2_ok;
    logic        head_can_issue;
    logic        head_store_ready;
    logic        head_load_ready;
    logic        head_issue_fire;
    logic        req_accept;
    logic        req_owner_match;
    logic        head_resp_fire;
    logic        head_resp_stale;
    logic        head_load_done;
    logic        head_store_done;
    logic [31:0] head_addr;
    logic [31:0] head_imm;
    logic [3:0]  head_be;
    logic [31:0] head_wdata;
    logic [31:0] load_word;
    logic [31:0] load_data;
    logic [2:0]  head_funct3;
    logic        disp_fire;
    logic        disp_to_head;
    logic        disp_to_tail;
    logic        disp_rs1_eff;
    logic        disp_rs2_eff;
    logic        squash_head;
    logic        squash_tail;
    logic        store_commit_match_head;
    logic        store_commit_match_tail;
    logic        head_remove;
    logic        tail_remove;

    logic        head_rs1_next;
    logic        head_rs2_next;
    logic        tail_rs1_next;
    logic        tail_rs2_next;

    assign head_valid = ent_valid[0];
    assign tail_valid = ent_valid[1];

    assign lsu_prf_rs1_addr = ent_valid[0] ? ent_prs1[0] :
                              (ent_valid[1] ? ent_prs1[1] : 6'd0);
    assign lsu_prf_rs2_addr = ent_valid[0] ? ent_prs2[0] :
                              (ent_valid[1] ? ent_prs2[1] : 6'd0);

    assign head_imm = ent_is_store[0] ?
                      {{20{ent_insn[0][31]}}, ent_insn[0][31:25], ent_insn[0][11:7]} :
                      {{20{ent_insn[0][31]}}, ent_insn[0][31:20]};

    assign head_addr = lsu_prf_rdata1 + head_imm;

    assign head_funct3 = ent_insn[0][14:12];

    always_comb begin
        head_be    = 4'b0000;
        head_wdata = 32'd0;
        case (head_funct3[1:0])
            2'b00: begin
                head_be    = 4'b0001 << head_addr[1:0];
                head_wdata = {4{lsu_prf_rdata2[7:0]}};
            end
            2'b01: begin
                head_be    = head_addr[1] ? 4'b1100 : 4'b0011;
                head_wdata = {2{lsu_prf_rdata2[15:0]}};
            end
            default: begin
                head_be    = 4'b1111;
                head_wdata = lsu_prf_rdata2;
            end
        endcase
    end

    assign head_rs1_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs1[0])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs1[0]));
    assign head_rs2_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs2[0])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs2[0]));
    assign tail_rs1_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs1[1])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs1[1]));
    assign tail_rs2_wake = (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (alu_complete_prd == ent_prs2[1])) ||
                           (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                            (load_complete_prd == ent_prs2[1]));

    assign tail_rs1_ready_eff = (ent_prs1[1] == 6'd0) ||
                                ent_rs1_ready[1] || tail_rs1_wake;
    assign tail_rs2_ready_eff = (ent_prs2[1] == 6'd0) ||
                                ent_rs2_ready[1] || tail_rs2_wake;

    assign head_rs1_ok = (ent_prs1[0] == 6'd0) || ent_rs1_ready[0] || head_rs1_wake;
    assign head_rs2_ok = (ent_prs2[0] == 6'd0) || ent_rs2_ready[0] || head_rs2_wake;

    assign head_load_ready  = ent_is_load[0] && head_rs1_ok;
    assign head_store_ready = ent_is_store[0] && ent_committed[0] &&
                              head_rs1_ok && head_rs2_ok;

    assign head_can_issue = head_valid && !ent_issued[0] && !halted && !flush &&
                            !req_active && (head_store_ready || head_load_ready);

    assign req_accept = lsu_dcache_req_valid && lsu_dcache_req_ready;
    assign req_owner_match = ent_valid[0] &&
                             (req_rob_q == ent_rob[0]) &&
                             (req_epoch_q == ent_epoch[0]);
    assign head_issue_fire = req_accept &&
                             (req_active ? req_owner_match : 1'b1);

    assign head_resp_fire = (ent_issued[0] || head_issue_fire) &&
                            lsu_dcache_resp_valid &&
                            (lsu_dcache_resp_epoch == ent_epoch[0]) &&
                            !squash_head;
    assign head_resp_stale = (ent_issued[0] || head_issue_fire) &&
                             lsu_dcache_resp_valid &&
                             (lsu_dcache_resp_epoch != ent_epoch[0]) &&
                             !squash_head;

    assign load_word = lsu_dcache_resp_rdata;

    always_comb begin
        load_data = load_word;
        case (head_funct3)
            3'b000: begin
                case (head_addr[1:0])
                    2'd0:    load_data = {{24{load_word[7]}},  load_word[7:0]};
                    2'd1:    load_data = {{24{load_word[15]}}, load_word[15:8]};
                    2'd2:    load_data = {{24{load_word[23]}}, load_word[23:16]};
                    default: load_data = {{24{load_word[31]}}, load_word[31:24]};
                endcase
            end
            3'b100: begin
                case (head_addr[1:0])
                    2'd0:    load_data = {24'd0, load_word[7:0]};
                    2'd1:    load_data = {24'd0, load_word[15:8]};
                    2'd2:    load_data = {24'd0, load_word[23:16]};
                    default: load_data = {24'd0, load_word[31:24]};
                endcase
            end
            3'b001: begin
                if (head_addr[1])
                    load_data = {{16{load_word[31]}}, load_word[31:16]};
                else
                    load_data = {{16{load_word[15]}}, load_word[15:0]};
            end
            3'b101: begin
                if (head_addr[1])
                    load_data = {16'd0, load_word[31:16]};
                else
                    load_data = {16'd0, load_word[15:0]};
            end
            default: load_data = load_word;
        endcase
    end

    assign head_load_done  = head_resp_fire && ent_is_load[0];
    assign head_store_done = head_resp_fire && ent_is_store[0];

    assign load_complete_valid     = head_load_done;
    assign load_complete_rob_index = ent_rob[0];
    assign load_complete_prd       = ent_pdst[0];
    assign load_complete_data      = load_data;

    assign store_done_valid     = head_store_done;
    assign store_done_rob_index = ent_rob[0];

    assign store_commit_match_head = store_commit_valid && ent_valid[0] &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index == ent_rob[0]);
    assign store_commit_match_tail = store_commit_valid && ent_valid[1] &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index == ent_rob[1]);

    assign squash_head = flush && ent_valid[0] &&
                         !((ent_rob[0] - flush_rob_index) & 4'h8);
    assign squash_tail = flush && ent_valid[1] &&
                         !((ent_rob[1] - flush_rob_index) & 4'h8);

    assign head_remove = ent_valid[0] &&
                         (head_load_done || head_store_done || squash_head);
    assign tail_remove = ent_valid[1] && squash_tail;

    assign lsu_dcache_req_valid     = req_active || head_can_issue;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_we        = req_active ? req_we_q : ent_is_store[0];
    assign lsu_dcache_req_addr      = req_active ? req_addr_q : head_addr;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_wdata     = req_active ? req_wdata_q : head_wdata;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_be        = req_active ? req_be_q : head_be;
    assign lsu_dcache_req_rob_index = req_active ? req_rob_q : ent_rob[0];
    assign lsu_dcache_req_epoch     = req_active ? req_epoch_q : ent_epoch[0];

    assign lsu_dcache_wait = (req_active || ent_issued[0]) &&
                             !lsu_dcache_resp_valid;

    assign lsu_idle = !ent_valid[0] && !ent_valid[1] && !req_active;

    assign lsu_disp_ready = rst_n && !halted && !flush &&
                            (!ent_valid[0] || !ent_valid[1]);
    assign disp_fire = lsu_disp_valid && lsu_disp_ready;

    assign disp_to_head = disp_fire &&
                          (!ent_valid[0] ||
                           (head_remove && (!ent_valid[1] || tail_remove)));
    assign disp_to_tail = disp_fire && !disp_to_head &&
                          ent_valid[0] && !ent_valid[1];

    assign disp_rs1_eff = (lsu_disp_prs1 == 6'd0) || lsu_disp_rs1_ready ||
                          (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (alu_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs1)) ||
                          (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (load_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs1));
    assign disp_rs2_eff = (lsu_disp_prs2 == 6'd0) || lsu_disp_rs2_ready ||
                          (alu_complete_valid && (alu_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (alu_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs2)) ||
                          (load_complete_valid && (load_complete_prd != 6'd0) &&
                           (load_complete_prd == lsu_disp_prs2));

    always_comb begin
        head_rs1_next = ent_rs1_ready[0];
        head_rs2_next = ent_rs2_ready[0];
        if (ent_valid[0] && !head_remove) begin
            if (head_rs1_wake) head_rs1_next = 1'b1;
            if (head_rs2_wake) head_rs2_next = 1'b1;
        end

        tail_rs1_next = ent_rs1_ready[1];
        tail_rs2_next = ent_rs2_ready[1];
        if (ent_valid[1] && !tail_remove) begin
            if (tail_rs1_wake) tail_rs1_next = 1'b1;
            if (tail_rs2_wake) tail_rs2_next = 1'b1;
        end

        if (disp_to_head) begin
            head_rs1_next = disp_rs1_eff;
            head_rs2_next = disp_rs2_eff;
        end else if (head_remove && ent_valid[1] && !tail_remove) begin
            head_rs1_next = tail_rs1_ready_eff;
            head_rs2_next = tail_rs2_ready_eff;
        end

        if (disp_to_tail) begin
            tail_rs1_next = disp_rs1_eff;
            tail_rs2_next = disp_rs2_eff;
        end
    end

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (!rst_n) begin
            ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b0;
            ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b0;
            ent_insn[0]       <= 32'd0;
            ent_insn[1]       <= 32'd0;
            ent_rob[0]        <= 4'd0;
            ent_rob[1]        <= 4'd0;
            ent_prs1[0]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_prs1[1]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_prs2[0]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_prs2[1]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_pdst[0]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_pdst[1]       <= 6'd0;
            ent_rs1_ready[0]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_rs1_ready[1]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_rs2_ready[0]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_rs2_ready[1]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_load[0]    <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_load[1]    <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_store[0]   <= 1'b0;
            ent_is_store[1]   <= 1'b0;
            ent_epoch[0]      <= 2'd0;
            ent_epoch[1]      <= 2'd0;
            ent_issued[0]     <= 1'b0;
            ent_issued[1]     <= 1'b0;
            ent_committed[0]  <= 1'b0;
            ent_committed[1]  <= 1'b0;
            req_active        <= 1'b0;
            req_we_q          <= 1'b0;
            req_addr_q        <= 32'd0;
            req_wdata_q       <= 32'd0;
            req_be_q          <= 4'd0;
            req_rob_q         <= 4'd0;
            req_epoch_q       <= 2'd0;
        end else begin
            ent_rs1_ready[0] <= head_rs1_next;
            ent_rs2_ready[0] <= head_rs2_next;
            ent_rs1_ready[1] <= tail_rs1_next;
            ent_rs2_ready[1] <= tail_rs2_next;

            if (store_commit_match_head) ent_committed[0] <= 1'b1;
            if (store_commit_match_tail) ent_committed[1] <= 1'b1;

            if (head_issue_fire) begin
                ent_issued[0]    <= 1'b1;
            end
            if (head_resp_fire || head_resp_stale) begin
                ent_issued[0] <= 1'b0;
            end
            if (head_resp_stale) begin
                ent_epoch[0]  <= flush_epoch;
            end

            if (!req_active) begin
                if (head_can_issue && !lsu_dcache_req_ready) begin
                    req_active  <= 1'b1;
                    req_we_q    <= ent_is_store[0];
                    req_addr_q  <= head_addr;
                    req_wdata_q <= head_wdata;
                    req_be_q    <= head_be;
                    req_rob_q   <= ent_rob[0];
                    req_epoch_q <= ent_epoch[0];
                end
            end else begin
                if (lsu_dcache_req_ready) begin
                    req_active <= 1'b0;
                end
            end

            if (head_remove) begin
                if (ent_valid[1] && !tail_remove) begin
                    ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b1;
                    ent_insn[0]       <= ent_insn[1];
                    ent_rob[0]        <= ent_rob[1];
                    ent_prs1[0]       <= ent_prs1[1];
                    ent_prs2[0]       <= ent_prs2[1];
                    ent_pdst[0]       <= ent_pdst[1];
                    ent_is_load[0]    <= ent_is_load[1];
                    ent_is_store[0]   <= ent_is_store[1];
                    ent_epoch[0]      <= ent_epoch[1];
                    ent_issued[0]     <= ent_issued[1];
                    ent_committed[0]  <= ent_committed[1] |
                                         store_commit_match_tail;
                    ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b0;
                    ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b0;
                end
            end else if (tail_remove) begin
                ent_valid[1] <= 1'b0;
            end

            if (disp_to_head) begin
                ent_valid[0]      <= 1'b1;
                ent_insn[0]       <= lsu_disp_insn;
                ent_rob[0]        <= lsu_disp_rob_index;
                ent_prs1[0]       <= lsu_disp_prs1;
                ent_prs2[0]       <= lsu_disp_prs2;
                ent_pdst[0]       <= lsu_disp_pdst;
                ent_is_load[0]    <= lsu_disp_is_load;
                ent_is_store[0]   <= lsu_disp_is_store;
                ent_epoch[0]      <= flush_epoch;
                ent_issued[0]     <= 1'b0;
                ent_committed[0]  <= lsu_disp_is_store && store_commit_valid &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index ==
                                      lsu_disp_rob_index);
            end else if (disp_to_tail) begin
                ent_valid[1]      <= 1'b1;
                ent_insn[1]       <= lsu_disp_insn;
                ent_rob[1]        <= lsu_disp_rob_index;
                ent_prs1[1]       <= lsu_disp_prs1;
                ent_prs2[1]       <= lsu_disp_prs2;
                ent_pdst[1]       <= lsu_disp_pdst;
                ent_is_load[1]    <= lsu_disp_is_load;
                ent_is_store[1]   <= lsu_disp_is_store;
                ent_epoch[1]      <= flush_epoch;
                ent_issued[1]     <= 1'b0;
                ent_committed[1]  <= lsu_disp_is_store && store_commit_valid &&
                                     (store_commit_rob_index ==
                                      lsu_disp_rob_index);
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
",
  "rtl/reorder_buffer.sv": "module reorder_buffer (
    input  logic        clk,
    input  logic        rst_n,
    input  logic        halted,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_valid,
    output logic        rob_alloc_ready,
    output logic [3:0]  rob_alloc_index,
    input  logic [31:0] rob_alloc_pc,
    input  logic [31:0] rob_alloc_insn,
    input  logic [5:0]  rob_alloc_pdst,
    input  logic [5:0]  rob_alloc_old_prd,
    input  logic [4:0]  rob_alloc_arch_rd,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_is_control,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_is_store,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_is_ecall,
    input  logic        rob_alloc_reg_write,
    output logic [3:0]  rob_head_index,
    input  logic        alu_complete_valid,
    input  logic [3:0]  alu_complete_rob_index,
    input  logic [31:0] alu_complete_data,
    input  logic        load_complete_valid,
    input  logic [3:0]  load_complete_rob_index,
    input  logic [31:0] load_complete_data,
    input  logic        resolve_valid,
    input  logic [3:0]  resolve_rob_index,
    input  logic        resolve_mispredict,
    input  logic [31:0] resolve_actual_next_pc,
    output logic        store_commit_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  store_commit_rob_index,
    input  logic        store_done_valid,
    input  logic [3:0]  store_done_rob_index,
    output logic        commit_valid,
    output logic [31:0] commit_pc,
    output logic [31:0] commit_insn,
    output logic [31:0] commit_value,
    output logic [4:0]  commit_arch_rd,
    output logic        commit_reg_write,
    output logic        commit_is_ecall,
    output logic        commit_old_prd_valid,
    output logic [5:0]  commit_old_prd,
    output logic        flush_valid,
    output logic [3:0]  flush_rob_index,
    output logic [31:0] flush_pc,
    output logic        ecall_pending
);

    localparam integer ROB_DEPTH = 8;

    logic [3:0] head;
    logic [3:0] tail;
    logic [3:0] count;

    logic        ent_valid    [0:7];
    logic [3:0]  ent_index    [0:7];
    logic        ent_complete [0:7];
    logic        ent_is_store [0:7];
    logic        ent_is_ecall [0:7];
    logic        ent_is_ctrl  [0:7];
    logic        ent_store_done [0:7];
    logic [31:0] ent_pc     [0:7];
    logic [31:0] ent_insn   [0:7];
    logic [31:0] ent_value  [0:7];
    logic [4:0]  ent_arch_rd[0:7];
    logic        ent_reg_write [0:7];

    logic [2:0] head_slot;
    logic [2:0] tail_slot;
    assign head_slot = head[2:0];
    assign tail_slot = tail[2:0];

    logic [3:0] tail_plus1;
    logic [3:0] head_plus1;
    logic       alloc_fire;
    logic       full;
    logic       empty;

    logic       head_valid;
    logic       head_complete;
    logic       head_is_store;
    logic       head_is_ecall;
    logic       head_store_done;
    logic       head_ready;

    logic       commit_pop;

                ent_is_ecall[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;

                tail <= flush_next4;

                    for (sq_i = 0; sq_i < 8; sq_i = sq_i + 1) begin
                        if (head_slot == sq_i[2:0]) begin
                            ent_valid[sq_i]          <= 1'b0;
                            ent_complete[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                            ent_is_store[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                            ent_is_ecall[sq_i]       <= 1'b0;
                            ent_is_ctrl[sq_i]        <= 1'b0;
                            ent_store_done[sq_i]     <= 1'b0;

                    head <= head_plus1;
